venue_name: Estadio Central (Demo Venue - FIFA World Cup 2026)

gates.name: Gate A - North
gates.description: Main entrance, nearest to metro station and main parking lot.

gates.name: Gate B - East
gates.description: Entrance closest to sections 100-120, near the fan zone.

gates.name: Gate C - South
gates.description: Entrance closest to sections 200-220, near VIP parking.

gates.name: Gate D - West
gates.description: Entrance closest to sections 300-320, near shuttle drop-off.

transport_options.details: Green Line to 'Stadium Central' station, 5 min walk to Gate A.
Free fan shuttle from Downtown Hub to Gate D, runs every 15 minutes on match days.
Designated rideshare pickup zone near Gate C, VIP parking side.

accessibility_services: Wheelchair-accessible entrances at Gates A, B, and D
Sensory-friendly quiet room located near Gate B, Concourse Level 1
Sign language interpreters available at Guest Services desks near every gate
Accessible seating available in Sections 105, 205, and 305 - contact Guest Services to arrange

faqs.question: Is outside food allowed?
faqs.answer: Outside food and drink are not permitted, except medically necessary items and small snacks for infants.

faqs.question: Where is the lost and found?
faqs.answer: Lost and Found is located at the Guest Services desk near Gate A.
